title: Ram Sufal v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sangeeta Chandra, J.; Brij Raj Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; EE to decide the Clause 6.5 bill-correction application within two weeks.
headnote: Where a consumer seeks correction of an electricity bill and has already moved the Executive Engineer, the High Court will not itself recast the bill in writ jurisdiction. The application is to be decided under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, here within two weeks of a certified copy being placed before the Executive Engineer, MVVNL, Rudawli, District Ayodhya.
facts: Ram Sufal filed a writ at the Lucknow Bench seeking mandamus to correct the electricity bill for connection No. 9160413000 and to have his representation dated 28 July 2025 decided under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for MVVNL (respondents 2 to 4) stated that the petitioner had already moved that application. The officer concerned was the Executive Engineer, MVVNL, Rudawli, District Ayodhya.

holding_units.holding: A consumer's pending application for correction of an electricity bill is to be decided by the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the High Court does not itself correct the bill in writ jurisdiction and instead directs that officer to decide the application within a fixed time.

not_decided.point: whether the petitioner's electricity bill for connection No. 9160413000 required correction
not_decided.note: merits of the bill left to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5
